gpu_tip: ~18GB total at 128K context — the smallest of the Qwen3.8 27B builds. Qwen3.8's hybrid Gated DeltaNet layers keep the KV cache small, so an 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 16GB DDR5 kit is enough via llama.cpp's per-layer offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~18GB — fits a 24GB MacBook Pro comfortably; a 16GB config is not enough.
